Water leaking onto a patio forms a circular pool. The radius of the pool increases at a rate of $3\,\text{m/min}.$ How fast is the area of the pool increasing at the moment when the radius is $\frac{5}{2\pi }\,\text{m}?$

The area of the pool is increasing at a rate of
{{field-1}} ${\text{m}}^{2}\text{/min}.$
